title: IIT2023-09-Chung-UpfrontTAD: Upfront TAD/SNB in Patients With Breast Cancer With Nodal Metastases
official: IIT2023-09-Chung-UpfrontTAD: Upfront TAD/SNB in Patients With Clinical T1-2N0 ER+ Her2- Breast Cancer With Ultrasound Detected Nodal Metastases
summary: The purpose of the study is to determine the recurrence rates and survival of patients with clinical T1-2N0 ER+/Her2- invasive breast cancer who have biopsy proven image detected nodal disease treated with upfront lumpectomy or mastectomy with TAD followed by adjuvant therapy. This is a prospective, single arm phase II clinical trial. Patients will be screened and enrolled per eligibility criteria. Patient, tumor, and treatment data will be documented.

interventions.name: Breast Surgery (BCS or mastectomy) with TAD/SNB

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Women age ≥ 45
* Clinical T1-2N0 ER+ invasive breast cancer
* US detected biopsy proven axillary nodal disease
* Written informed consent obtained from subject and ability for subject to comply with the requirements of the study.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Palpable nodes on physical exam
* Her2+ or ER- invasive breast cancer
* Extranodal extension \> 3 mm on nodal biopsy
* More than 2 suspicious nodes on preoperative imaging
